db.query.text.value: SELECT o.id, o.event_id, o.status, o.total_amount, o.currency, o.paid_at, o.payment_provider, o.variable_symbol, o.expires_at, p.bank_account AS promoter_bank_account, p.meta_pixel_id AS promoter_meta_pixel_id, u.email AS buyer_email, e.title AS event_title, e.date_start AS event_date_start, v.name AS venue_name, e.event_type, e.streaming_url, e.stream_replay_days FROM orders.orders o JOIN identity.users u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN catalog.events e ON e.id = o.event_id LEFT JOIN catalog.venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id LEFT JOIN platform.promoters p ON p.id = e.promoter_id WHERE o.id = $1
